BonusGame.name: Bonus game block main
summary: Main routine of sprite $82. Nine blocks (slots 1-9) cycle through nine symbols and travel around a rectangular track.
Mario hits one from below to freeze its symbol; when all are hit, lines of three equal symbols are counted.
Slot 1 also pays out rewards (CODE_01E26A). Blocks move one 8x8 grid step per corner, turning 90 degrees each time.

s01DEE3.name: Table: bonus block symbol tiles
summary: 4 tile numbers per symbol frame (indexed by [$1570] * 4).

s01DF07.name: Table: bonus block palette bits
summary: One per symbol frame.

s01DF10.name: Table: bonus block bounce height
summary: Indexed by [$1540] / 2.

s01DF19.name: Draw bonus game block
summary: Draws the symbol as four 8x8 tiles over a 16x16 base tile $E4, with the bounce offset from [$1540] and blinking when [$154C] is set.
Hits OAM slots at +$00 to +$13 of the sprite's OAM index.

s01DFC1.name: Table: bonus game winning lines
summary: 8 lines x 3 block positions: 0-7 = ring around the edge, 8 = center.

s01DFD9.name: Count bonus game matches
summary: For each of 8 lines of three positions, finds the three blocks, and if their symbols are equal counts it in [$1890] and starts their flash timers.
Plays sound $29 if any line matched, else $2A and sets [$14AB] = $58.

InitFireball.name: Init Podoboo fireball
summary: Remembers the spawn Y in [$1528]/[$151C], then moves the sprite down 16 pixels at a time until it is in lava, and picks a launch speed from the depth.

s01E07B.name: Table: Podoboo launch speed by depth
summary: Indexed by depth below the spawn point / 16.

s01E091.name: Table: Podoboo max fall speed
summary: Indexed by sprite state.

Fireballs.name: Podoboo and falling flame
summary: Main routine of sprite $33 (Fireball) and $B5 (sinking fireball). State 0: Podoboo that jumps out of lava, waits $60-$9F frames, repeats.
Other state: a flame that swerves left and right on a timer, lands and turns into smoke.

BowserFlameTiles.name: Flame draw and Podoboo graphics setup
summary: $01E190: tile table for the flame. $01E198 (state 0): draws the Podoboo and sets the dynamic graphics source addresses $0D8B/$0D95.

InitKeyHole.name: Init keyhole
summary: Moves the sprite 8 pixels right.

Keyhole.name: Keyhole main
summary: Finds the key sprite ($80) and checks contact between it (or Mario when on Yoshi) and the keyhole. On contact starts the keyhole exit: timer [$1434], music change, sprites locked, position saved.
Draws the keyhole as two 8x8 tiles.

s01E2B0.name: Unused data
summary: $FF padding and values $13-$19.

MontyMole.name: Monty Mole main
summary: Sprites $4D and $4E. State dispatch: 0 wait underground, 1 pop out, 2 in air, 3 walk/hop toward Mario.

Ptrs01E2D8.name: Monty Mole states and routines
summary: Pointer table, then state 0 and 1 code (wait until Mario is near; spawn dirt and the mole hole).

s01E363.name: Draw shaking Monty Mole
summary: State 1 for sprite $4E: frame 3 with random flip bits.

s01E38F.name: Table: Monty Mole speeds
summary: Hop speeds and max walk speeds.

s01E393.name: Monty Mole states 2 and 3
summary: State 2: in the air. State 3: walk toward Mario or hop after him. Includes the common move/draw routine CODE_01E3EF.

DryBonesAndBeetle.name: Dry Bones and Bony Beetle main
summary: Sprites $30-$32. If not status 8, flips the sprite upside down and jumps to the dead sprite code at CODE_01E5BF.
